data.name: DeepSpaceDiesel
data.detailed_description:
WE'RE FINE. EVERYTHING IS FINE.

Have you ever dreamed of leaving it all behind to run a cozy, profitable business in the serene void of space? Well, the Monolithic Corporation has a ✨once-in-a-lifetime opportunity✨ for you! Welcome to Deep Space Diesel, the premiere (and only) diesel station in this sector.

Your job is simple: manage your station, make money, and serve a delightful parade of cute, chunky cruisers. It's a satisfying loop of capitalist bliss. What could possibly go wrong?

(Imagine a GIF here of a cute, colorful ship docking, followed by a one-frame flash of something monstrous)

SERVE, EARN, EXPAND!

The core of your new life is the grind. Master the fueling mini-games, set your prices, and watch the space-cash roll in! Use your profits to:

  • PRIME YOUR PUMPS: Install faster nozzles, bigger tanks, and even fully automated fueling arms so you can focus on the important things, like counting your money.

  • BUILD A BUSINESS EMPIRE: Add a convenience store! Sell space snacks! Become the beacon of commerce you were always meant to be!

  • DEFEND YOUR DOUGH: Pirates want your stuff. They're basically just aggressive customers. Set up laser and missile turrets to give them a very loud, very explosive "no thank you." BOOM BOOM.

(Imagine a screenshot of the bright, clean station with lots of upgrades)

THE WALLS ARE WHISPERING...

Things break down. You'll have to crawl into the dark, cramped maintenance tunnels to fix them. But you're not alone down there. The station... hums. The lights flicker. You'll find... notes. Scrawls from the last manager. You'll hear things. You'll see things when you turn around too fast.

This is where the real choice begins. Do you ignore the creeping dread and focus on your quarterly reports, or do you start pulling at the threads of a terrifying mystery?

(Imagine a screenshot of a dark maintenance tunnel with a cryptic symbol scrawled on the wall)

CHOOSE YOUR FATE: GRIND OR ESCAPE?

Deep Space Diesel offers two fundamentally different paths driven by your choices:

  • The "Remain" Path: Embrace the corporation. Max out your station, become a diesel tycoon, and learn to love the friendly whispers. The customer is always right, even if the customer is a hallucination born of diesel fumes and existential terror.

  • The "Escape" Path: This is where things get tricky. You'll need to follow clues, solve puzzles, and secretly funnel your earnings into an escape fund. Will you bribe a smuggler? Befriend a quirky captain? Or maybe even... stow away on a pirate ship? Freedom isn't free, and every dollar you save is a dollar you're not spending on that shiny new turret.

The very fumes you sell are eroding your sanity. The cute ships will begin to look... wrong. The friendly UI will start showing you things you can't unsee. Your grip on reality is as stable as a three-legged space-badger.

Will you build an empire or will you break free? The choice is yours.

No pressure.

data.short_description: Welcome to your new career as a gas station attendant in the deepest, darkest corner of space! Serve adorable ships, count your cash, and expand your diesel empire. It's a simple, satisfying job. Just... ignore the whispers in the vents. Everything is fine. Probably.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-Core processor, 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible card with 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad-Core processor, 3.0 GHz+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / 1660, AMD Radeon RX 580
